revision.description: the serial of this revision; it only grows, so a replayed older revision is refused. The desk writes it.

home.description: the home that masters these grants (scope.home)

revocations.description: a union of revoked grant ids: a revoked grant never returns (federation.propagation.merge)

suspensions.description: suspensions of a person; lifted only by two people other than the suspender

catalogue.description: entitlements with an owner and a risk class

root.description: the root role of the tenant's group tree and who held it when; delegations hang off the role

on_call.description: may raise and confirm levels, never lower them

groups.description: managed groups in the administrative tree

delegations.description: delegations of group administration, each narrowing its parent

admin_revocations.description: retirement or revocation of a delegation or membership

persons.description: one person with several anchors is one person; kind decides who may be a deputy or member

unit.description: the organisational unit (an org_units id) the person belongs to; a sibling deputy's key counts only from another unit (decision 0008)

owner.description: who answers for a workload or an agent: a person of the organisation

director.description: an agent's director: the person or workload it acts for

situation_feeds.description: registered external feeds that may raise restriction levels

surge_packages.description: access packages for new personnel during a raised level, prepared in peacetime

front_office.description: who issues badges at this place (decision 0009, D4), appointed by the steward

org_units.description: logical org units and the physical places they occupy

badge.description: the badge kind entering this zone needs (decision 0009)

approval_proofs.description: proofs that each approval is the approver's own: an ID token the broker signed after a fresh sign-in, whose nonce is the statement of the records it covers (decision 0006); they only grow

proposal_proofs.description: proofs that a high-risk record is its proposer's own: an ID token the broker signed after a fresh sign-in, whose nonce is the proposal statement of the records it covers (decision 0015); they only grow

approvers.description: named approvers: people appointed to give second keys, by the root with the security officer's key, for a limited time (decision 0008)

visits.description: visits: the only thing that admits someone on site (decision 0009)

parties.description: visits made by 0.10.0 to 0.12.0 (read as they are; new visits use attendees)

attendees.description: the people of the visit, one each (decision 0010)

escorts.description: internal staff who accompany guests that may not walk unescorted

visit_events.description: what happened on a visit, append-only (decision 0009)

qr.description: a digest of the issued QR code, never the code

badges.description: visit badges issued by a place's front office (decision 0009, D4)

accounts.description: decision 0028: one record per internal anchor, entering with the change that first names it. Its commit is sha256(salt || the identity provider's id), the salt kept in the erasable anchor_map: every mapping row is checkable against the log, and once erased the commitment points at nobody

edges.description: edges: site appliances that enforce leases on a bastion, enrolled by the root with the security officer's key (decision 0014)

custodians.description: the people an edge may escrow break-glass halves to (two different people per value)

unlock_key.description: the edge node's P-256 public key for phoned unlock (kc-unlock-v2), uncompressed SEC1, base64url

unlock_approvers.description: who may read an unlock code to a person on site (never that person)

tpm.description: an assured edge's TPM (decision 0016): the EK the officer pinned on site, its certificate if any, the attestation key, the PCR baseline; the officer signs its commitment

statement.description: the kc-edge-officer-v2 statement, multi-signed over the same bytes by the officer and each node of the edge (amendment 0014d); the engine checks it says what the record holds

person_keys.description: person keys: X25519 public keys derived from a passkey through WebAuthn PRF, and the SSH key a hardware key holds (decision 0014)

edge_visit_leases.description: visit leases: one edge, one person, their SSH key, named targets and a window of their own (decision 0014)

edge_rotations.description: a new enrolment key or a new officer for an edge, signed by both, with the security officer's key (decision 0014c)

statement.description: the kc-edge-officer-v2 statement, multi-signed over the same bytes by the officer and each node of the edge (amendment 0014d); the engine checks it says what the record holds

unlock_key.description: the edge node's P-256 public key for phoned unlock (kc-unlock-v2), uncompressed SEC1, base64url

anchor.description: immutable identifier from the source, never a name or mail

kind.description: a subject kind the configuration lists (grant_limits.subject_kinds)

level.description: a scope level the configuration lists (grant_limits.scope_levels)

change.description: the merge request or ticket that carried the approval

identity_hash.description: keyed hash of the verified identity fact, kept for totals

issuer.description: the connected organisation's issuer for a partner

kind.description: a subject kind the configuration lists (grant_limits.subject_kinds)
